mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate at 0.14% is below the historical average, compressing discount rates in equity valuation models and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in CPIAUCSL above 235.0 signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 235.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 7.5% and the employment level (PAYEMS) falls below 135000.0 (thousands), it indicates a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE>7.5 and PAYEMS<135000.0.

mechanism_narrative: During recessions defined by two consecutive quarters of declining real GDP (GDPC1), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings and increased risk aversion.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decline in two consecutive quarters
regime_hint: recession (GDPC1 decline in two consecutive quarters)
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances during two consecutive quarters of declining GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 8.0%, it signals a weak labor market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE>8.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900.0 and retail sales (RSAFS) fall below 418000.0, it signals a weakening demand environment that reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST<900.0 and RSAFS<418000.0.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 100.0, it signals strong economic activity that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO>100.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 950.0, it signals a strong housing market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST>950.0.
